Sharpe''' (born November 6, 2001) is an American [[basketball]] player. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[North Carolina Tar Heels men's basketball|North Carolina Tar Heels]]. ==High school career== Sharpe began his high school career playing for [[South Central High School (North Carolina)|South Central High School]] in [[Winterville, North Carolina]]. As a sophomore, he averaged 14.3 points and 9.3 rebounds per game.{{cite news |last1=Pope |first1=Jonas |title=What kind of player is UNC getting in big man Day’Ron Sharpe? |url=https://www.charlotteobserver.com/sports/college/article213390014.html |access-date=December 1, 2020 |work=[[Charlotte Observer]] |date=June 18, 2018}} Sharpe averaged 16.5 points and 10.7 rebounds per game as a junior, helping South Central finish with a 30–1 record and win the NCHSAA Class 4A state title. He announced he was transferring to [[Montverde Academy]] for his senior season.{{cite news |last1=Pope |first1=Jonas |title=UNC 2020 basketball commit, Day’Ron Sharpe to transfer |url=https://www.newsobserver.com/sports/college/acc/unc/article233272213.html |access-date=December 1, 2020 |work=[[The News & Observer]] |date=July 29, 2019}} Sharpe averaged 12.1 points and 7.3 rebounds per game as a senior, leading Montverde to a 25–0 record and No. 1 national ranking according to MaxPreps.{{cite web |last1=Jones |first1=Andrew |last2=King |first2=Deana |title=The Final Book On Day'Ron Sharpe |url=https://northcarolina.rivals.com/news/the-final-book-on-day-ron-sharpe |website=[[Rivals.com]] |access-date=December 1, 2020 |date=April 11, 2020}} He was named a [[McDonald's All-American Game|McDonald's All-American]] as well as a [[Jordan Brand Classic|Jordan Brand All-American]].{{cite news |last1=McMillan |first1=Sherrell |title=Four UNC Signees Named McDonald's All-Americans |url=https://247sports.com/college/north-carolina/Article/Four-UNC-Basketball-Signees-Named-McDonalds-All-Americans-142517274/ |access-date=December 1, 2020 |work=247 Sports |date=January 23, 2020}}{{cite news |last1=Martin |first1=Ross |title=Three UNC Signees Named to Jordan Brand All-Star Game |url=https://247sports.com/Article/Three-UNC-Signees-Named-to-Jordan-Brand-All-Star-Game-143832932/amp/ |access-date=December 1, 2020 |work=247 Sports |date=February 15, 2020}} In AAU play, he played for Garnet Road.{{cite news |last1=Jordan |first1=Jason |title=adidas Gauntlet: UNC commit Day’Ron Sharpe motivated to kickoff spring/summer ball |url=https://usatodayhss.com/2019/adidas-gauntlet-unc-commit-dayron-sharpe-motivated-to-kickoff-spring-summer-ball |access-date=December 1, 2020 |work=[[USA Today]] |date=April 13, 2019}} ===Recruiting=== Sharpe was considered a five-star recruit ranked the No. 5 center in the class of 2020 and the No. 22 overall player by [[247Sports.com|247Sports]]. He committed to [[North Carolina Tar Heels men's basketball|North Carolina]] on June 17, 2018, becoming the first member of the class of 2020 to commit to the Tar Heels. Sharpe turned down scholarship offers from [[Virginia Cavaliers men's basketball|Virginia]], [[East Carolina Pirates men's basketball|East Carolina]] and [[Georgetown Hoyas men's basketball|Georgetown]]. {{College Athlete Recruit Start|40=no|collapse=no|year=2020}} {{College Athlete Recruit Entry | recruit = Day'Ron Sharpe | position = [[Center (basketball)|C]] | hometown = [[Greenville, North Carolina|Greenville, NC]] | highschool = [[Montverde Academy]] (FL) | feet = 6 | inches = 10 | weight = 246 | 40 = | commitdate = June 17, 2018 | scout stars = | rivals stars = 5 | 247 stars = 5 | espn stars = 5 | espn grade = 94 }} {{College Athlete Recruit End | 40 = | year = 2020 | rivals ref title = North Carolina 2020 Basketball Commitments | scout ref title = | espn ref title = 2020 North Carolina Tar Heels Recruiting Class | rivals school = northcarolina | scout s = | espn schoolid = 153 | 247 overall = 22 | rivals overall = 13 | espn overall = 12 | accessdate = December 1, 2020 | bball = yes }} ==College career== In Sharpe's freshman debut on November 25, 2020, he had 13 points and 10 rebounds in a 79–60 win against [[College of Charleston Cougars men's basketball|College of Charleston]].{{cite news |title=Freshmen lead No. 16 UNC past College of Charleston 79–60 |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401252794 |access-date=December 1, 2020 |work=[[ESPN]] |agency=[[Associated Press]] |date=November 25, 2020}} He become the fourth North Carolina player to record a double-double in his debut game, joining [[Lennie Rosenbluth]], [[Sam Perkins]], and [[Cole Anthony]].{{cite news |last1=Brown |first1=C.L. |title=UNC basketball: Day’Ron Sharpe gives North Carolina’s frontcourt an edge |url=https://www.newsobserver.com/sports/college/acc/unc/article246969592.html |access-date=December 1, 2020 |work=[[The News & Observer]] |date=November 25, 2020}} Sharpe averaged 9.5 points and 7.6 rebounds per game as a freshman. On March 24, 2021, Sharpe declared for the [[2021 NBA draft]], ending his career as a Tar Heel.{{cite news |last1=Boone |first1=Kyle|title=2021 NBA Draft: North Carolina's Day'Ron Sharpe declares as potential first-round selection |url=https://www.cbssports.com/college-basketball/news/2021-nba-draft-north-carolinas-dayron-sharpe-declares-as-potential-first-round-selection/ |access-date=July 6, 2021 |work=[[CBS Sports]] |date=March 24, 2021}} ==Career statistics== {{NBA player statistics legend}} ===College=== {{NBA player statistics start}} |- | style="text-align:left;"| [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2020–21]] | style="text-align:left;"| [[2020–21 North Carolina Tar Heels men's basketball team|North Carolina]] | 29 || 4 || 19.2 || .519 || .000 || .505 || 7.6 || 1.4 || .8 || .9 || 9.5 {{S-end}} ==References== {{Reflist}} ==External links== *[https://goheels.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/day-ron-sharpe/22193 North Carolina Tar Heels bio] *[https://mvasports.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/day-ron-sharpe/1386 Montverde Academy Eagles bio] *[https://www.usab.com/basketball/players/mens/s/sharpe-dayron.aspx USA Basketball bio] {{DEFAULTSORT:Sharpe, Day'Ron}} [[Category:2001 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:American men's basketball players]] [[Category:Basketball players from North Carolina]] [[Category:Centers (basketball)]] [[Category:Montverde Academy alumni]] [[Category:North Carolina Tar Heels men's basketball players]] [[Category:Sportspeople from Greenville, North Carolina]] [[Category:Power forwards (basketball)]] [[Category:African-American basketball players]]
